title: Greeting, Qualifications for Elders

questions.question: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, for the sake of the ____ of God's elect and their knowledge of the truth,
questions.explanation: Titus 1:1 (ESV): "Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, for the sake of the faith of God's elect and their knowledge of the truth, which accords with godliness,"

questions.question: In hope of eternal life, which God, who never ____, promised before the ages began
questions.explanation: Titus 1:2 (ESV): "in hope of eternal life, which God, who never lies, promised before the ages began"

questions.question: Paul left Titus in ____, so that he might put what remained into order, and appoint elders in every town.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:5 (ESV): "This is why I left you in Crete, so that you might put what remained into order, and appoint elders in every town as I directed you—"

questions.question: An elder must be above reproach, the husband of one wife, and his children are ____ and not open to the charge of debauchery or insubordination.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:6 (ESV): "if anyone is above reproach, the husband of one wife, and his children are believers and not open to the charge of debauchery or insubordination."

questions.question: For an overseer, as God's ____, must be above reproach.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:7 (ESV): "For an overseer, as God's steward, must be above reproach. He must not be arrogant or quick-tempered or a drunkard or violent or greedy for gain,"

questions.question: He must hold firm to the trustworthy word as taught, so that he may be able to give instruction in ____ doctrine and also to rebuke those who contradict it.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:9 (ESV): "He must hold firm to the trustworthy word as taught, so that he may be able to give instruction in sound doctrine and also to rebuke those who contradict it."

questions.question: For there are many who are insubordinate, empty talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision ____.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:10 (ESV): "For there are many who are insubordinate, empty talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision party."

questions.question: They must be silenced, since they are upsetting whole families by teaching for shameful ____ what they ought not to teach.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:11 (ESV): "They must be silenced, since they are upsetting whole families by teaching for shameful gain what they ought not to teach."

questions.question: One of the Cretans, a prophet of their own, said, "Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy ____."
questions.explanation: Titus 1:12 (ESV): "One of the Cretans, a prophet of their own, said, 'Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.'"

questions.question: Therefore rebuke them ____, that they may be sound in the faith,
questions.explanation: Titus 1:13 (ESV): "This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,"

questions.question: not devoting themselves to ____ myths and the commands of people who turn away from the truth.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:14 (ESV): "not devoting themselves to Jewish myths and the commands of people who turn away from the truth."

questions.question: To the ____, all things are ____, but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is ____; but both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:15 (ESV): "To the pure, all things are pure, but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their minds and their consciences are defiled."

questions.question: They profess to know God, but they ____ him by their works.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:16 (ESV): "They profess to know God, but they deny him by their works. They are detestable, disobedient, unfit for any good work."

questions.question: They are detestable, disobedient, unfit for any good ____.
questions.explanation: Titus 1:16 (ESV): "They profess to know God, but they deny him by their works. They are detestable, disobedient, unfit for any good work."

questions.question: Which of these is NOT listed in verse 7 as a disqualification for an overseer?
questions.explanation: Titus 1:7 (ESV): "For an overseer, as God's steward, must be above reproach. He must not be arrogant or quick-tempered or a drunkard or violent or greedy for gain," (Age is not explicitly mentioned here, unlike in 1 Timothy 3 where "recent convert" is mentioned).

key_verse_text: To the pure, all things are pure, but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
